How to play Resonance Spire

Recreate the design in the reference panel. Rotate it to see the other sides, then build on the empty grid using the cubes in your tray. The game completes the level when your build matches.

  1. Choose a cube. Click the grid to place it or click the top or upper half of a cube to stack it.
  2. Use Build level to place at a specific height or reach an interior position. Stacking on the selected level automatically advances it.
  3. Complete all 20 designs to unlock Crystal Sanctuary Freeplay. Start empty or use the castle starter, then save and reopen your creation on this device.
  4. Right-click a cube to return it to the tray. On a touchscreen, hold a cube to remove it.
  5. Drag to orbit and scroll or pinch to zoom. With the build area focused, use arrow keys to select a cell, Enter to place, and Delete to remove.
